description: Lists every workspace the user belongs to, marks the one this connection acts on, and says what each allows through the connector: none (Free or no plan) or full (Solo, Growth, Pro). Use this when the user names another workspace or a tool reports a plan lock; then switch_workspace moves the connection. Returns workspaces[] (id, name, slug, isOwner, current, plan, access). Does NOT switch, create or change any workspace.
name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
